meta.name: li-inbox
meta.description: Triage the LinkedIn inbox - sort connection requests and DMs into leads, recruiters, peers and spam, and draft the replies worth sending. Use when the user says "my inbox is a mess", "triage my DMs", "should I reply to this", pastes a batch of LinkedIn messages, or is drowning in connection requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把领英收件箱里的连接请求和私信分类,并起草值得回复的内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在领英收到大量连接请求和私信,理不清谁值得回复。
copy.tagline_en: Sort your LinkedIn inbox and draft the replies worth sending
copy.fit_line_en: For you if LinkedIn DMs and connection requests are piling up and you can't tell who to answer.

howto.what: 把粘贴给它的 LinkedIn 私信和好友请求分成 LEAD、RECRUITER、PEER、ASK、SPAM 五类,先报各类数量,再只为该回的那几类起草可直接发送的回复,并标出哪些是自动化群发。
howto.when: 当你提到「收件箱乱成一团」等说法、粘贴一批 LinkedIn 消息,或被好友请求淹没时触发。它只处理你粘贴的内容,不登录你的账号。

say.text: 帮我分拣下面这批 LinkedIn 消息,先给出各类数量
say.note: 按五类分组,计数排在最前

say.text: 这封私信该不该回?要回的话给我草稿
say.note: 判断类别,只在值得回时起草

say.text: 这封招聘私信是真的吗?帮我问薪资区间、级别和是否坐班
say.note: 生成一条追问这三项信息的回复

howto.what_en: Claude sorts the LinkedIn DMs and connection requests you paste into five buckets - LEAD, RECRUITER, PEER, ASK, SPAM - gives counts first, then drafts replies only for the buckets worth answering, flagging automated sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "my inbox is a mess" or similar, paste a batch of LinkedIn messages, or are drowning in connection requests. It only reads what you paste; it never logs into your account.

say_en.text: Triage this batch of LinkedIn messages and show me the counts first.
say_en.note: Groups them into five buckets, counts first.

say_en.text: Should I reply to this DM? Draft it for me if so.
say_en.note: Sorts it, drafts only if worth sending.

say_en.text: Is this recruiter real? Ask for comp band, level, and in-office.
say_en.note: Drafts one line asking the three missing details.
